label: excludes from capture
type: the subject monitoring, auditing or recording mechanism deliberately omits the object from what it records.
note: Distinct from the promoted disablesFeatureFor (a feature unavailable to an audience). This is a scope boundary on an observability mechanism, and it is the kind of fact that is invisible until it matters: AWR does not capture CREATE USER or ALTER USER statements, and SQL++ auditing omits three named API codes. Both are exactly the sort of gap a compliance question turns on.
